text: **dsh-agent-reach**（DSH 技能）：为 DSH agent 注册 Agent Reach 网络能力技能。插件通过 DSH skills 服务读取随包提供的技能正文，并以可由模型或用户调用的方式注册。技能引导 agent 使用命令行工具阅读网页、获取 YouTube 字幕、查询 GitHub、Twitter/X、Reddit 与 RSS，并进行 Exa 语义搜索；也列出 Bilibili 和小红书等渠道。适合需要 agent 查阅在线页面、视频字幕或信息源的场景。使用前需安装上游 Agent Reach CLI；可选平台需要相应登录凭据或 cookie。

**dsh-agent-reach** is a DSH skill that registers Agent Reach instructions for agents. The skill guides use of its CLI to read web pages, find YouTube subtitles, search GitHub and Exa, and access RSS and social sources. Install the upstream CLI first; optional channels need credentials or cookies.
想让 DSH agent 能搜索网页并读取网页内容。
有没有办法让 agent 获取 YouTube 视频字幕？
I want my DSH agent to search the web and read online sources.
**dsh-agent-reach** 的功能「联网资料访问」：注册 Agent Reach 技能，引导 agent 通过 CLI 阅读网页、获取 YouTube 字幕并查询 GitHub、RSS 等来源。
dsh-agent-reach 使用前须知：技能文档说明 Twitter/X、小红书、Reddit 等可选渠道需要对应登录凭据或 cookie；Groq key 也是单独配置的可选项。

dsh-agent-reach README · dsh-agent-reach：[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-agent-reach)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent gains one-command internet reach — web reading, YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X, Reddit, RSS, Exa semantic search, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu and more — via the [Agent Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach) CLI.

dsh-agent-reach README · dsh-agent-reach：> **How it differs from MCP bundles:** Agent Reach is a CLI capability layer + agent skill, **not** an MCP server. This bundle therefore registers an **in-process DSH skill** (`ctx.skills.register`) instead of an `mcp-client` row — the skill teaches the agent to install the CLI on first use and drive its upstream tools (yt-dlp, gh, opencli, twitter-cli, bili-cli, mcporter/Exa, feedparser).

dsh-agent-reach README · What it adds to every agent on the profile：| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `agent-reach-skill` | `dsh-agent-reach` (this bundle's own module) | Registers the `agent-reach` skill in the DSH skill registry — install guide, health checks (`agent-reach doctor`), optional channels (cookies/proxy/keys), and the full upstream command reference |

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (skills service); agent-reach CLI needs Python ≥ 3.10

text:
dsh-agent-reach README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-agent-reach
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-agent-reach`.

After install, restart or re-apply, then ask any agent: *"use the agent-reach skill to give yourself internet access"* — it will install the CLI and run `agent-reach doctor`.

dsh-agent-reach README · Requirements & permissions：- The **skill** itself is self-contained (no runtime deps beyond DSH)
- The **CLI** is installed by the agent on first use: Python ≥ 3.10 (+ pipx or venv); core channels (web, YouTube, GitHub, RSS, Exa search, V2EX, Bilibili) are free and keyless; optional channels (Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Boss直聘) need cookies/login and your explicit approval
- Cookies stay local in `~/.agent-reach/`; nothing is uploaded
- Upstream tools are re-selected upstream when platforms break — you don't maintain them
dsh-agent-reach README · Publish / uninstall：Push updates to the GitHub repo and bump `"version"`; hub users get update prompts. Remove from the profile `bundles` + `dependencies` to uninstall.

dsh-agent-reach README · Credits：Upstream project: [Panniantong/agent-reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach) (MIT) — this bundle only packages its skill for the DeepSeek Harness skill registry.
